REGISTRAION OF TITLE ACT, NO. 21 OF 1998

(Section 14) In regard to the title to parcel of land No.313 of Block 21 contained in the Cadastral Map No. 520001 situated in the village of Homa-gama within the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 486C - Galavilawatta North in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Homagama in the District of Colombo in the Province of Western published in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 1703/35 of 29th April 2011. “ 313 ” mentioned in the column of “ Parcel No.” is amended as “ 361 ” of the schedule, “0.2786 Hectare” in the column “ Extent” is amended as “0.2578 Hectare” of the schedule. GAMINI ILANGARATHNA, Commissioner of Title Settlement. Land Title Settlement Department, 1200/6, “Mihikatha Medura” Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla 05th November, 2014. 12 - 394 / 1
